abilities.Multiscale: Halves the damage the Pokemon takes while its HP is full.
abilities.Mummy: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Mummy.
abilities.Natural Cure: The Pokemon's status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.
abilities.No Guard: The accuracy of moves used both by and against the Pokemon becomes 100%.
abilities.Oblivious: The Pokemon cannot gain the Infatuated or Taunted statuses and is unaffected by Intimidate.
abilities.Opportunist: When an opponent's stats are boosted, the Pokemon boosts its own stats in the exact same way.
abilities.Overcoat: The Pokemon takes no damage from sandstorms and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder.
abilities.Overgrow: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's Grass-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.
abilities.Own Tempo: The Pokemon cannot become confused and is unaffected by Intimidate.
abilities.Parental Bond: The parent and child attack one after the other. The power of the child's attacks is 1/4 of those of the parent.
abilities.Pickpocket: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, it will steal the held item of the attacker if it is not already holding an item.
abilities.Pickup: If the Pokemon is not already holding an item, at the end of the turn it will pick up an item that was consumed by another Pokemon.
abilities.Piercing Drill: When the Pokemon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
abilities.Pixilate: The Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
abilities.Plus: Boosts the Pokemon's Sp. Atk stat by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
abilities.Poison Heal: If poisoned or badly poisoned, the Pokemon has 1/8 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn instead of losing HP.
abilities.Poison Point: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
abilities.Poison Touch: When the Pokemon hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
abilities.Prankster: Increases the priority of the Pokemon's status moves by 1 stage.
abilities.Pressure: Causes opponents to expend 1 more PP when using moves against the Pokemon.
abilities.Protean: Changes the Pokemon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once per time the Pokemon enters battle.
abilities.Psychic Surge: Sets Psychic Terrain for five turns when the Pokemon comes in.
abilities.Punk Rock: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's sound moves by 30% and halves the damage it takes from sound moves.
abilities.Pure Power: Doubles the power of the Pokemon's physical moves.
abilities.Purifying Salt: Halves the damage the Pokemon takes from Ghost-type moves. The Pokemon is immune to status conditions.
abilities.Queenly Majesty: Opponents are unable to use priority moves against the Pokemon or its allies.
abilities.Quick Draw: The Pokemon's moves have a 30% chance of going first among moves of the same priority.
abilities.Quick Feet: When the Pokemon has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Pokemon's Speed stat.
abilities.Rain Dish: The Pokemon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain.
abilities.Rattled: Raises the Pokemon's Speed by one stage when it is hit by a Bug, Dark or Ghost-type move, or by Intimidate.
abilities.Receiver: The Pokemon changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally.
abilities.Reckless: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's moves by 20% if they have recoil or crash damage.
abilities.Refrigerate: The Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
abilities.Regenerator: The Pokemon has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.
abilities.Ripen: Doubles the effects of Berries eaten by the Pokemon.
abilities.Rivalry: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's moves by 25% against targets of the same gender, and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender. The power remains the same as usual if either Pokemon's gender is unknown.
abilities.Rock Head: The Pokemon will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.
abilities.Rough Skin: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP.
abilities.Run Away: The Pokemon can always flee from a wild battle. It has no effect in a battle against another trainer.
abilities.Sand Force: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm.
abilities.Sand Rush: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
abilities.Sand Spit: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokemon takes damage from moves.
abilities.Sand Stream: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters a battle.
abilities.Sand Veil: Boosts the Pokemon's evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm.
abilities.Sap Sipper: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokemon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat by 1 stage.
abilities.Scrappy: The Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
abilities.Screen Cleaner: When the Pokemon enters a battle, it removes the Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil statuses.
abilities.Seed Sower: Sets Grassy Terrain for five turns when the Pokemon is hit by a move.
abilities.Shadow Tag: Opponents cannot be switched out of battle.
abilities.Sharpness: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's slicing moves by 50%.
abilities.Shed Skin: The Pokemon has a 30% chance of curing its own status conditions at the end of every turn.
abilities.Sheer Force: The Pokemon's moves lose their additional effects, but the power of those moves will be boosted by 30%.
abilities.Shell Armor: Attacks landed on the Pokemon will never be critical hits.
abilities.Shield Dust: The Pokemon is immune to additional effects from attacks.
abilities.Skill Link: The Pokemon's multistrike moves always hit the maximum number of times.
abilities.Slush Rush: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat in snow.
abilities.Sniper: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.
abilities.Snow Cloak: Boosts the Pokemon's evasiveness by 25% in snow.
abilities.Snow Warning: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters a battle.
abilities.Solar Power: In harsh sunlight, the Pokemon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50%, but it loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn.
abilities.Solid Rock: Reduces the damage the Pokemon takes from super-effective moves by 25%.
abilities.Soundproof: The Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves.
abilities.Speed Boost: Boosts the Pokemon's Speed stat by 1 stage at the end of every turn.
abilities.Spicy Spray: When the Pokemon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
abilities.Stakeout: Doubles the damage dealt to a Pokemon that switched in this turn.
abilities.Stall: The Pokemon's moves go last among moves of the same priority.
abilities.Stalwart: The Pokemon ignores the effects of Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
abilities.Stamina: When the Pokemon takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted by 1 stage.
abilities.Stance Change: The Pokemon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King's Shield.
abilities.Static: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.
abilities.Steadfast: When the Pokemon flinches, its Speed stat is boosted by 1 stage.
abilities.Steely Spirit: Boosts the power of Steel-type moves used by the Pokemon and its ally by 50%.
abilities.Stench: When the Pokemon deals damage with its moves, there is a 10% chance that targets will flinch.
abilities.Sticky Hold: The Pokemon's held item cannot be stolen or removed by other Pokemon.
abilities.Strong Jaw: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's biting moves by 50%.
abilities.Sturdy: If the Pokemon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokemon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.
abilities.Suction Cups: The Pokemon is unaffected by the moves and held items of other Pokemon that would force it to switch out of battle.
abilities.Super Luck: The Pokemon has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
abilities.Supersweet Syrup: When the Pokemon enters a battle, opponents' evasiveness is lowered by 1 stage. This Ability is triggered only once per battle.
abilities.Supreme Overlord: When the Pokemon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokemon in its party that has been defeated in the battle already. The maximum boost is 50%.
abilities.Surge Surfer: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
abilities.Swarm: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's Bug-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.
abilities.Sweet Veil: The Pokemon and its allies cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.
abilities.Swift Swim: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat in rain.
abilities.Symbiosis: When an ally consumes an item, the Pokemon gives its own held item to that ally.
abilities.Synchronize: If the Pokemon is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Pokemon's move or Ability, that Pokemon will also be inflicted with the same status condition.
abilities.Tangled Feet: Doubles the Pokemon's evasiveness if it is confused.
abilities.Technician: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's moves by 50% if their power is 60 or less.
abilities.Telepathy: The Pokemon dodges attacks from its allies.
abilities.Thermal Exchange: Raises the Pokemon's Attack by one stage when it is hit by a Fire-type move, and it cannot be burned.
abilities.Thick Fat: Halves the damage the Pokemon takes from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
abilities.Torrent: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's Water-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.
abilities.Tough Claws: Boosts the power of the Pokemon's contact moves by 30%.
abilities.Toxic Debris: When the Pokemon takes damage from a physical move, it gives the opponent's side the Toxic Spikes status, which sets Toxic Spikes on their field.
abilities.Trace: When the Pokemon enters a battle, it changes its Ability to match that of an opponent.
abilities.Unaware: The Pokemon ignores the target's stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker's stat changes when being attacked. It cannot ignore changes to the Speed stat, however.
abilities.Unburden: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat when its held item is consumed or lost.
abilities.Unnerve: Makes opponents unable to eat Berries.
abilities.Unseen Fist: When the Pokemon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
abilities.Vital Spirit: The Pokemon cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.
abilities.Volt Absorb: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokemon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.
abilities.Wandering Spirit: When the Pokemon is hit by a contact move, it swaps Abilities with the attacker.
abilities.Water Absorb: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokemon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.
abilities.Water Bubble: Halves the damage the Pokemon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokemon cannot be burned.
abilities.Weak Armor: When the Pokemon takes damage from a physical move, its Defense stat is lowered by 1 stage, but its Speed stat is boosted by 2 stages.
abilities.White Smoke: The Pokemon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokemon's moves or Abilities.
abilities.Zero to Hero: The Pokemon changes into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.
